title: Upload: a filename carrying slashes becomes nested directories inside the storage root (`../../etc/passwd` is stored under `user/ID./etc/passwd`)
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced on a public entry (reach below).

QA-source: #32135 · attachments-storage.field-accept-maxsize-server-enforced · observed beside the clauses
Batch-of: objectstack-ai/objectstack#32135 follow-ups, 15 cards filed on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」

## What we saw

Reach: `POST /api/v1/storage/upload/presigned` and the upload that follows, as a signed-in member (framework ff04ad81, local storage driver). Traversal is neutralised (the key stays inside the root), but the extension or name taken from the filename keeps its `/`, so the object key gains nested directories derived from user input.

## Proposed change

Derive the stored key's extension from a sanitised basename (no path separators, a bounded charset), keeping the original name only as metadata.

## Business reason

Who: every deployment storing uploads. Cost: storage layout shaped by user input, and fragile behaviour on drivers where `/` means something.

## Reader

Triage first touch; lands in `packages/services/service-storage` (key derivation).

## Duplicate check

`is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack upload filename slash storage key` (3: QA run records and a seat post) and `upload key sanitize filename` (4: #23932 is about the refusal envelope): no card.
